title: VNC connection fails with "Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'stream')" on 1.78.2 Nightly Build 3405
author: Magved
body_snippet:
## Summary

I'm reporting a reproducible issue affecting VNC connections in mRemoteNG Nightly Build 3405.

The same x11vnc server works correctly with the current Stable release.

## Environment

- mRemoteNG 1.78.2 Nightly Build 3405 (x64)
- Windows 11 25H2
- x11vnc 0.9.16
- Protocol: RFB 3.8
- Security type: VNC Authentication (type 2)

## Reproduction Steps

1. Run mRemoteNG 1.78.2 Nightly Build 3405 x64.
2. Create or open a VNC connection to an x11vnc server using RFB 3.8 and VNC Authenticati...

comments.author: eran132
comments.snippet:
I tracked this down — it isn't a VNC protocol, RFB-version or authentication problem at all. **Every VNC connection is broken**, and x11vnc/RFB 3.8/security type 2 are coincidental.

## Root cause

`VncSharpCore` 1.2.1 (the NuGet package the app uses) is missing an embedded resource that the library itself requires. `RemoteDesktop.SetState(RuntimeState.Connected)` does the equivalent of:

```csharp
Cursor = new Cursor(GetType(), "Resources.vnccursor.cur");
```
